name: Do different types of shower valves require different repair approaches?

mainEntity.name: Do different types of shower valves require different repair approaches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, different types of shower valves—such as cartridge, compression, or thermostatic valves—require distinct repair approaches and specific replacement parts. For example, a cartridge valve repair often involves replacing the entire cartridge, while a compression valve might only need new washers. Understanding the valve type is crucial for an effective repair. Our skilled plumbers are experienced with all common valve types found in Las Vegas homes and carry a variety of parts to ensure efficient service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, different shower valve types like cartridge or compression valves require specific repair methods and parts.
